notes.title: 1.2 Coming Soon, Patch, and Cloud Saves
notes.notes:
The Steam cloud saves finally work on MacOS! It should also be working cross-platform as well. The backup-save system we made is still in place as well, in case there are more trouble ahead.

This is a smaller patch, in preparation for 1.2, adding a few more suggestions and fixing some bugs. 

1.1.1 Changelog:


 Steam cloud saves should now work on all platforms!
 Chess pieces now avoid moving behind the Grandmaster
 Added a toggle to use a 2D Planet, for any players having graphical issues with the 3d planet model.
 Tweaked some of the encounter generation to avoid bad encounters.
 Combo now resets at the start of your turn for better timing with the Time Angel.
 Fixed Toy Bomb previews with Red Giant
 Added missing tags for Nova Control
 Fixed Bash and Last Resort not counting as "push" cards
 Fixed invisible cursor on rewinding
 Fixed sometimes the artifact reward on the globe scene goes out of the screen with the steam deck
 Fixed Jab upgraded cards not counting as "random" cards
 Fixed Quick Restart with the daily run creating too many modifiers
 Fixed missing localization for Regenerating Shield
 Fixed Discard Pile number not matching when playing with Pickups
 Throw Junk achievement now triggers correctly with more types of throws
 Attempted improvements to performance across the board.
 Fixed French localization not working in the Mac build.


Since we've been working in parallel on the update, some of the fixes for a few extra known bug reports (such as the bestiary issues) will be fixed in 1.2, coming at the end of the month.

September 29 - Night of the Invaders

We're about the begin the beta for 1.2 in our discord server this week or next week, come join and check out the new content! The public release is planned to be September 29th, to coincide with the Steam Autumn Festival.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/5a041f2c3138258de9dfc9f55c4550ff2ba7322d.png"]

Are those new invaders???





1.2 - Night of the Invaders will include:

- 6 new invaders! (with their basic and advanced variants)

- Full Moon Pack: A pack that plays with Sacrifice and Isolated invaders.

- Academy Pack: A pack that focuses on manipulating Starter Cards. 

- A bunch of new achievements!

Things are speeding up for the rest of the year. The next update after that (1.3) will be coming sooner than later (November 21st!). We'll be starting the beta for that one in October. 

We hope everyone enjoyed their summer vacations! The team took some good time off as well, but now we're all back to work. There's some exciting things coming ahead - stay tuned!

- Axolotl of the Pengonauts

notes.title: 1.1 - Beach Episode ~ Our first major update is live!
notes.notes:
FYI we are gonna be in the Summer Sale with a 10% discount starting on the 26th.



It's finally Summer (in the northern hemisphere) and the pilots are enjoying a well-earned break after fighting invaders in countless timelines. Check out what's new in the 1.1 update below!



We've also finally reached over 2000 overwhelmingly positive reviews at 98%! 



It's honestly so insane to me, I never would have thought so many people would enjoy our very wacky, very specific design philosophy. I've thanked you all so many times already but you really don't know how helpful it is to us indie devs.


[hr][/hr]
If you missed it, here's a recap of what we've done between 1.0.0 and 1.0.7:


1.0.0 ~ 1.0.7 Notable Updates Recap:
Added Savescum Mode and Infinite Chronos assist mode toggles

Buffed Roxy and Noel's starting decks

Improved the clarity and balance of the [spoiler]True ending and Hemophage boss fights[/spoiler] to make them feel better to play against

Fixed dozens of bugs, crashes and localization issues of all types

Much more! check out the full changelog of all updates in our previous news posts.
[hr][/hr]

1.1.0 - BEACH EPISODE: 

[New!] Sandbox Settings


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/fc88ee1644e0a3818165a30db156d81d4a1db019.png"]

Adjust the game to your liking with the Sandbox Settings, a new menu to tweak the game with. 



Notable features include:

Optional customization of difficulty with new settings based on player suggestions.

Ban specific packs and bosses from appearing during gameplay.

We will continue to add to the Sandbox Settings based on player feedback and suggestions!


[New!] Beach Pack


Part of the magic of the "Pack System" is that it lets us add a lot more variety and mechanics without diluting the card pool as is often a problem in many deckbuilders with a lot of content. 



We will be able to add as many packs as we can think of, and each one added will expand the variety of the card pool across multiple runs. And if you do not enjoy the new packs, you can always disable them in-game with the new sandbox settings! 



The first new pack post-release is the Beach Pack, themed around "random" synergy. Randomness is not always dangerous, sometimes it can be harnessed and used to your advantage.



Use the Pocket Sand to strike random invaders while sifting through your deck, or throw the Beach Ball at other invaders with big splash damage. (Beach Ball is one of my new favorite Items to build around!)



This pack is designed to synergize with the existing card pool too. The Roadtrip card will return all cards that mention "random" from your discard pile to your hand, and the Lucky Dice artifact will improve the odds of ALL random-related artifacts and cards from other classes and packs!



Discover these in-game after you unlock the Beach Pack through earning trophies!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/b44c2a85816d739acca75a0a3aa2c8f126246594.png"]


[New!] Buncha Artifacts


We're adding a new neutral Legendary, and each pilot gets a new pilot-unique Common artifact that explores a bit more of their unique mechanics! 



Some of these are references to content creators who played the game that we really enjoyed, try to guess who they are!





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/3342c523325e43bbf58738e2ecc69aa34427116d.png"]
[New!] Kaia Skin for the Supporter Pack!


There is a new beach-themed skin for Kaia in the Supporter Pack! (in addition to the 3 existing skins)



If StarVaders has been fun for you and you'd like to help us continue working on the game, the Supporter Pack is a wonderful way to show your support!



We (Pengonauts) are a small and new 3-person studio based in Montreal, Canada. StarVaders is our first game, but we have many great plans ahead for both StarVaders and other games beyond! 



We’re grateful for any help, but remember – buying the pack is entirely up to you, and your enjoyment of the game is what matters the most! The supporter pack is purely cosmetic and won’t affect the gameplay experience.



We've just created a new bundle, where you can get the supporter pack and the soundtrack at an additional 10% discount, check it out here!

StarVaders - Support the Team! Bundle



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/fa2f95a3671cb4460ab311e294d6fa71b19d1bcd.png"]


Notable QoL Improvements


On the Character Selection screen, there is now an indicator for the highest difficulty the pilot has won with.

Challenges now show a different trophy when they've been completed with the True Ending (this is not retroactive so only new runs will update it).

Regenerating Shield now has its own, more visible section in the description, and has been added to the bosses that it applies to that was missing that information.


Notable Balance Changes


Zeke has been buffed to start with Echo on their Nova Bomb instead of a Heated. 



Zeke has had problems with setup and early-game, which became a lot more apparent after the buffs to Roxy and Noel. Changing the Nova Bomb upgrade gives Zeke a strong AOE setup early and also helps showcase his ability to dismantle self-purging cards as an advantage.



It's not the biggest buff but it does give him the much needed early game tempo to be able to get off the ground easier and build towards something stronger. 



Doom Ritual has been reworked to only activate if no other invaders are channeling Doom. 


Other


Buffed Chant (from Dark Medal), now draws a card.

Buffed Dawnbreaker and Nightbringer, now only increases cost of Sun/Moon cards by 1.

Nerfed Hologram, now 1 cost instead of 0 cost.

Added a countdown for when the Daily Run resets

Orchids and other similar simultaneous  doom + attacking invaders now attack before channeling Doom.

Added animations for Min! (very important)

Added whiff indicator to Static Wave

Added more info tooltip for Robo-Parrot

Added a toggle in the settings for increasing danger zone visibility on the grid.

Buffed Gunner Assist!, now fires 2 additional rockets

Ghosts can no longer gain immunity while they are channeling Doom.

Added some modding-framework related changes to the codebase in preparation for modding

Improved the clarity of a few boss descriptions

Fixed several missing card tags

Fixed bug involving entities floating above holes

Fixed a few mouse-hover input related bugs where some entities are too close to each other

Fixed Ultra Coolant crashing on a no-commons pool modifier run.

Fixed missing 2x Legendary Special reward on a no Legendary pool modifier run.

Increased Guide scale for better readability

Fixed Visual overlap of completion star in more info

Fixed Summon limit text overlapping with Bomb limit

Fixed Summon limit text not updating when max Summon limit is changed

Attempted fix on Nessie freeze when defeated

Attempted fix on settings scene crash due to resolution errors

Attempted performance improvements and fixes for memory leaking

Many localization changes based on suggestions.


[hr][/hr]


Hope you all enjoy! The update is live now!



Other than any immediate bug fixing patches, the next big content update will be Update 1.2 around September / October.  It will be very scary and have a bigger focus on new gameplay content! The beta for it will be up in the next few months, so stay tuned!



- Axolotl of the Pengonauts

notes.title: Update 1.1 Teaser & Beta Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey pilots! Hope you are all doing well!

It's been exactly 1 month since our full release and we've been so happy to see the response from you all! A lot of gratitude for all the feedback and reviews you have left us, they've helped tremendously.

Following that, we're excited to announce that the game is doing well enough for us to continue improving it and adding more content with free updates, starting with the 1.1 update coming in [strike]two[/strike] a few weeks!   
Update 1.1: Coming Soon!

We've been pretty busy during release month fixing a lot of the major bugs and crashes that have been reported, but now that things have stabilized a bit better we will be slowling down our rate of patching to work on bigger content updates.

Here are some of the planned new content that will be available in the 1.1 update:


Sandbox Settings:

We've added a bunch of customization features since release based on player feedback (such as save-scum mode for example). To expand on that, I've decided to create a whole menu for more customization of the game. 

Included in the new sandbox settings will be new options inspired by player feedback such as:

- Add more granular post-Apocalypse challenges with smaller steps in between each difficulty.
- Post-Apoc no longer shortens each act.
- Ban specific bosses from appearing (great for achievement hunting!)
- More...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/61080667b692c6d08974dee967ad096b3e1a7d2b.png"]Did someone say they want more ascensions??

Just to make it clear, the DEFAULT difficulties will not change, but we will be adding new options to customize the difficulty for players.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/bd8b1e180cb8bae9296f4e53ddbe6c65fdbbb33d.png"]
I'm personally pretty open to allow players to play the game the way they want to play, so if it's not too hard to implement I don't mind adding new options based on suggestions! Let us know what you'd like to be able to customize in game.


New Cards and Artifacts:

There will be a new, summer-themed neutral pack, as well as new pilot-unique common artifacts for each pilot! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/b44c2a85816d739acca75a0a3aa2c8f126246594.png"]Vamos a la playa!

I should warn that the new card pack might be based on a potentially controversial mechanic haha, but at least with the Sandbox Settings you'll be able to ban specific packs from appearing too, so if you don't like the new pack you can disable them from in-game!


Beta Build

We will be opening up a beta build (probably on Monday) to start playtesting the 1.1 update. More information about that will be shared on our Discord and QQ groups. The beta will also only be available in English and Chinese.

Starting from now, we will also likely be pushing updates and the usual patches to the beta first, before updating the main build. That should prevent some of those awkward hot-fixes for crashes i accidently introduce in the last minute, oopsie.


Other Additional Notes


Steam Cloud Saves for Mac...

We've tried to enable steam cloud-saves a couple times for Mac for the past few weeks, but everytime we did it, Steam decides it's ok to delete the entire save directory without warning, deleting all progress from Mac users. 

We've even implemented a backup folder that is seperate from the steam cloud specified directory to avoid this specific problem, but apparently that entire backup folder gets deleted by Steam cloud too even though it's not in the path that steam cloud is supposed to update... So for now we've disabled Steam cloud saves for Mac and are waiting on a solution from Steam Support so that we can enable it without deleting any progress.


Optimization Issues

We've also gotten your reports on optimization issues, potentially some sort of memory leak as well on long playtimes. We haven't quite figured it out yet, but are working on it. 

If you are experiencing strange amounts of lag or stutterring, please use the in-game bug report form if possible to send us a report! That'll help us figure out the cause, thanks!


Thanks for everything - Pengonauts

A huge thanks again for everyone. To wrap up this too-long news post, we wanted to highlight a few of the content creators that have believed in us, as well as some of the amazing fan-art created by the community so far! Check it out:

notes.title: 1.0.3 - Day 2 Patch
notes.notes:
Heya, another day, another patch. 

We really appreciate all the bug reports and the feedback that's been coming in! Some notable changes in this update include:

 A new Save Scum extras option that makes it so when you exit and resume an encounter, it starts from start of the fight instead of where you left off.
 [Spoiler]Overseer Phase 2 transition now resets your energy and draws 3 cards for you[/spoiler]
 Tweaked some of the encounter algorithm to create less "really bad" encouters.

Other:

 Fixed gamepad input resetting when rewinding
 Fixed a [spoiler]Nessie task engine crash when it eats a bomb in phase 2[/spoiler]
 Fixed Chain Lightning and Translocate, now playable without summons
 Fixed Salve causing everything to become free when combined with Cold Star
 Fixed not having any rewards anymore when using Infinite Rerolls to reroll rewards for a long time
 Fixed some visual bugs in the glossary involved artifact & their completion stars
 Fixed a few localization issues
 Fixed Red Brand showing up in double artifact reward
 Attempted fix on inconsistency in achievement for not picking up artifacts
 Hypermode Shun now correctly starts with 2 Battery.


Unless there are some serious issues we will likely not have a patch during the weekend, so see you next week! Keep slaying those invaders! 

If you are enjoying your time it helps us out so much to leave a review! 

We also have a fun discord community you can join here. We've got both long time players and newcomers all discussing strategies and showing off their decks. We will also be starting some cool activities soon inside the discord server!

Thanks, 

- Axolotl

notes.title: 1.0.2 - Day 1 Patch
notes.notes:
Wow, it's been great to see all the feedback so far. 

We've added a few more options in the settings menu for you to customize how you wanna play the game. Although the "axolotl's prefered way" to play remains the same, more options never hurt anybody! 

Sorry if you encountered that major looping softlock when losing in the [spoiler]Overseer[/spoiler] fight, this has been fixed! If you are still in a run and it is still not working you might need to delete that run from the main menu (or abandon the run). 

New Gameplay Options

 Added a button in the settings to unlock only pilots and the [spoiler]daily run[/spoiler]
 Added an Extras option to made Chrono Rewinds during the encounter NOT reshuffle your deck.
 Added an Extras option to give infinite Chrono Tokens.


Other

 Added an option to remove the "F2 Bug Report" prompt
 Buffed Noel, she now starts with an Artillery Fire!
 Added the Bomb keyword to entities that are considered Bombs.
 Rerolling [spoiler]fragments of LINK always gives a different modifier[/spoiler]
 Fixed a major bug that happens when you lose against the [spoiler]Overseer[/spoiler]
 Attempting a fix on missing resolutions based on base monitor resolution
 Attempting a fix on a bug that prevented the settings menu from applying changes
 Fixed a Task Engine Crash with the [spoiler]Grandmaster[/spoiler]
 Fixed a Task Engine Crash involving Transmogrify and special upgrade cards (like Shadow Kunai)
 Fixed Ricochet Fire! + Lazer Bullets being 1 tile too short
 Fixed Enhance (Keeper spell) not targetting random cards
 Fixed Thundersquall - now correctly only targets invaders, and range is accurate
 Fixed a few localization strings and incorrect tags
 Fixed bug preventing typing 1, 2, 3 in the seed
 Attempting to fix a bug caused by patches messing with save files (caused you to start a run with the deck from the previous run)


This is just a first batch of bug fixes, we've still got a few to tackle. Thank you for the meal! (axolotls eat bugs) 

Keep sending them over!

- Axolotl

notes.title: 0.7 - NEMESIS Update
notes.notes:
This year is gonna be an insane year for us. (and most likely the release year?)

We definitely skipped the demo versions 0.6, but that's because those updates mostly added new systems to the beta - Now we're back with 0.7 with a changelog that doesn't even fit in a single steam post! 


Let's get straight to the point:

What's new in 0.7?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/318ed3b7b6c2f3131e2881372bff0983eea4758f.png

2 New Bosses, 5 New Invaders! ​

We've almost doubled the content of the demo! Fight the mysterious Shambler in act 1, and defeat the very chessy Grandmaster in act 3!

The rest of the invaders are slowly unlocked as you play the game - but they will change things up quite a bit! The Virus adds negative components to your cards and the Fallen Angel let's you trade Doom for Stars!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223353/0e4203d94121396d02d5c89de1e2081344200760.gif 

We've listened to the feedback!

Of course we always listen to the feedback, but many of the major topics that come up have been finally been completely taken care of:

- Better Tutorial (again): Tutorials are hard! We've remade the tutorial again to be even clearer, and also now added a quick guide for anyone who skips the tutorial or needs a quick reminder!

- Doom System: Slightly reworked to improve the pacing and challenge of the game, with more interesting decision making involved with reducing Doom as well.

- Skippable Repeats and Moves: You can now skip repeats with selections and moves that could be otherwise detrimental for you! We're giving even more control to the player.

- Improved Upgrades: We've realized with your help that the upgrade system wasn't reaching its full potential - so I've redesigned a lot of upgrades, and added new artifacts with a focus on making it feel like upgrades are an even more significant factor in how the player crafts their build.

- You can now push invaders out of the "Doom zone" to stop them from channelling Doom: This was probably one of the most requested feature haha, but we've figured out a way to get it to work intuitively without breaking any of the more advanced invader designs!

... and more!

Some of the craziest Deckbuilder QoL you've ever seen!

- Context-Relevant Previews: Whenever you pick a card or artifact, you'll see the relevant cards in your deck!

- Guaranteed Draw Previews: Whenever you draw cards (and its a guaranteed hit), it will show you what you draw!

- Artifact Trigger Previews: Whenever a card-related artifact triggers, it will show up on the card itself as a big reminder!

- Deck Preview: Hover over your deck or discard pile to see what's in it!

- Better Enemy Panels: Enemies now tell you how much doom and stars they make!

... and more...

 And much more! The changelog is so massive it literally doesn't fit in this steam post, If you're really curious, all the changes are written progressively in our beta channel on our discord!

What's next?

LOCALIZATION! We're about to localize the demo into many, many languages. I'm super excited to bring the game to other parts of the world and excited to get more feedback as well!

We are also starting some big activities and participating in quite a few upcoming festivals soon - spread the hype! We won't be in the february next fest though, but our demo and beta is not going anywhere!

This year will be HUGE for us, and I am so happy to have all of your support to help our team thrive! Can't announce anything more - but do stay tuned!


Join our discord for beta testing!

In the meantime, if you're starving for more content, please join our Discord server and request access to our beta! We are still testing the second mech and difficulty levels in our closed beta, with some crazy new content on the way too!

Download the demo here!
Join our Discord if you have feedback!


Don't forget to Wishlist the game! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097570/StarVaders/
